This geometry appears ethereal and endless, suggesting a vast, structured environment. All connected nodes pulse rhythmically with a deep, rich violet light. Crucially, these pulses are asynchronous, meaning that no two nodes pulse at the same time. The entire lattice structure is perpetually dynamic, shifting and breathing with slow, subtle changes in glow and pattern, creating a mesmerizing field of color and light.
